categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polystyrene (PS) high-molecular new materials. The main products are general-purpose polystyrene (GPPS) and high-impact polystyrene (HIPS), which are widely used in electronics, optical displays, toys, daily plastic products, packaging, building materials, and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs mature polystyrene production technology with advanced polymerization techniques. It utilizes a 'GPPS 1+4' and 'HIPS 2+4' reactor configuration mode, enabling multi-stage polymerization and hierarchical reaction control. The company possesses strong formula design capabilities and equipment process improvement expertise, with 25 accumulated patents including 2 invention patents and 23 utility model patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves large and medium-sized enterprises primarily in the home appliance, lighting, and electronics industries. Key customers include Midea, Oma, Haier, Suzhou Sanxin, TCL, and Kangkang. The company also serves well-known traders in the industry. Products are applied in optical displays, optical lighting, refrigerator interior components, home appliances, medical devices, and food packaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Huizhou Daya Bay Petrochemical Industrial Zone, Guangdong Province, China. Its main operating regions include South China (Guangdong) and East China. The company has established a subsidiary, Jiangsu Zhuowei Chemical Co., Ltd., for trading operations. Products are primarily distributed in South China and East China regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the supply chain, positioned between raw material suppliers (particularly Sinopec Shell) and downstream manufacturers. It purchases styrene monomer as raw material and produces polystyrene resins for downstream processors and manufacturers. The company benefits from a unique '隔墙供应、管道输送' (wall-separated supply, pipeline transport) arrangement with Sinopec Shell.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing high-end, specialized polystyrene products with emphasis on optical-grade materials, heat-resistant formulations, and impact-resistant variants. R&D priorities include low-processing-temperature GPPS for diffusion boards, XPS foam applications, high-gloss HIPS products, and medical-grade low-residual-monomer materials. The company aims to expand into new application fields including new energy vehicles, medical devices, and electronic components.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of polystyrene products to industrial customers and traders. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer signature confirmation. The company employs both direct sales to manufacturers and sales through trading intermediaries, with approximately 65% from traders and 35% from factory customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to Zhuochuang Information, the company ranks 6th nationally and 2nd in South China among polystyrene producers with annual production capacity of 300,000 tons. The company competes in a market with significant supply-demand imbalance, where low-end products face intense competition while high-end specialty products remain in short supply. The company differentiates through superior product quality and specialized formulations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of 1.979 billion yuan (down 18.95% year-over-year) and net profit attributable to shareholders of 55.79 million yuan (down 40.69% year-over-year). Total assets reached 1.958 billion yuan as of December 31, 2023, up 87.45% from year-end 2022. The company completed its IPO in July 2023, issuing 36.23 million shares at 26.68 yuan per share, raising 887.28 million yuan in net proceeds.
